objective: Resolve and combine coplanar forces, then determine the magnitude and direction of the single resultant while preserving axis and quadrant conventions.
prerequisites: Use signed Cartesian components, degree-based angles, vector addition, the Pythagorean magnitude relation, and atan2 quadrant handling.

worked_example.entry_description: Resolve two coplanar forces into x and y components, sum them, and reveal the resultant magnitude and atan2 direction.
